cases.problem_statement: Fix src/bounds.py so clamp(value, lower, upper) returns value constrained inclusively to the supplied lower and upper bounds. Keep the public function signature unchanged and run the visible tests.
cases.test:
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parents[1] / "src"))
from bounds import clamp


def test_clamp_respects_both_bounds() -> None:
    assert clamp(-2, 0, 10) == 0
    assert clamp(4, 0, 10) == 4
    assert clamp(12, 0, 10) == 10

cases.problem_statement: Fix src/options.py so parse_enabled accepts only the documented case-insensitive tokens true/false, yes/no, and 1/0 after surrounding whitespace is removed. It must raise ValueError for any other token. Run the visible tests.
cases.source:
def parse_enabled(value: str) -> bool:
    return bool(value)
cases.test:
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parents[1] / "src"))
from options import parse_enabled


def test_parse_enabled_accepts_documented_tokens() -> None:
    assert parse_enabled(" YES ") is True
    assert parse_enabled("0") is False


def test_parse_enabled_rejects_unknown_token() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_enabled("sometimes")

cases.problem_statement: Fix src/ranges.py so values_between returns every integer from start through stop, including both endpoints. Keep ascending behavior and run the visible tests.
cases.source:
def values_between(start: int, stop: int) -> list[int]:
    return list(range(start, stop))
cases.test:
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parents[1] / "src"))
from ranges import values_between


def test_values_between_is_inclusive() -> None:
    assert values_between(3, 3) == [3]
    assert values_between(2, 5) == [2, 3, 4, 5]
